Description: Unique reservation identifier, numbered in order of booking date
Arrival (check-in) date. The dataset covers every day from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31
Date the reservation was made (Date minus Lead Time)
Check-out date (Date plus LOS)
Property of the booking
Example or allowed values: City Hotel (60 rooms), Resort Hotel (66 rooms)

Description: Room category booked
Example or allowed values: Standard Room, Superior Room, Deluxe Room, Junior Suite, Suite, Deluxe Garden View, Deluxe Pool View, Family Room, Villa

Description: Rooms of this type in inventory at this hotel
Rooms of this type occupied at this hotel on the night of Date (excludes cancelled bookings). Same value for all rows with the same hotel, room type and date
Total rooms in the hotel
Total rooms occupied in the hotel on the night of Date
Hotel Occupied Rooms divided by Hotel Available Rooms, in percent
ADR multiplied by LOS for stayed bookings, 0 for cancelled bookings
Food and restaurant spend for the stay, 0 for cancelled bookings
Bar spend for the stay, 0 for cancelled bookings
Spa and wellness spend for the stay, 0 for cancelled bookings
Meeting and event spend, mainly from Group and Corporate bookings
Other ancillary spend such as parking, laundry and minibar
Sum of room, restaurant, bar, spa, meeting/event and other revenue
Channel through which the booking was made
Example or allowed values: Online Travel Agency, Direct Website, Phone/Email, Travel Agent/Tour Operator, Global Distribution System, Corporate Booking Tool, Front Desk

Description: Type of customer
Example or allowed values: Leisure, Business Transient, Corporate Contract, Group, Tour Operator, Complimentary

Description: Rate plan booked
Example or allowed values: Best Available Rate, Advance Purchase, Package, Member Rate, Corporate Rate, Group Rate, Wholesale Net Rate, House Use

Description: Meal plan booked
Example or allowed values: Room Only, Bed & Breakfast, Half Board, Full Board

Description: Average daily rate per room night. 0 for Complimentary stays
Length of stay in nights (1 to 14)
Days between Booking Date and Date (0 to 365)
Number of adults
Number of children
Adults plus Children
Guest's country of residence (synthetic mix)
Example or allowed values: Germany, United Kingdom, France, Netherlands, United States, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, Austria, Poland, Other

Description: 1 if the guest has stayed before, 0 otherwise
Block identifier for group bookings. Rows with the same ID share arrival date, lead time and LOS. Blank for non-group bookings
Demand event on the arrival date at that hotel
Example or allowed values: No Event, Trade Fair, Holiday Period

Description: Weekday of the arrival date
Month name of the arrival date
Season of the arrival date (meteorological)
Whether the booking was cancelled before arrival
